# Scene Pack Conformance Fixture

This fixture is a verbatim snapshot of Luminous Platform's First Germination example at:

- Repository: https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/luminous-platform
- Source commit: `a9ba54242d19579f5d84e03e8fae483678aa3f24`
- Source path: `contracts/examples/first-germination.scene.json`
- Source Git blob SHA-1: `98165b8958f0121825fa28e373521bb61ce9078c`

It is a pinned cross-target test input, not a second source of truth, a runtime Scene Pack loader, or proof that the current renderer implements every manifest field. Updating it should include a deliberate source-commit change and an interoperability review. Presentation selection, safe regions, static-fallback activation, lifecycle policy, manifest/schema validation and whole-process memory accounting remain separate host/loader qualification work.
